decisions.reason: Turnaround management software sits close to the core offer and has its own web page, so it likely meets aspirations, and a growing, investing firm has the slack to keep developing it.

The apron connectivity module underpins the integrated digital apron strategy, and with no evident shortfall and slack from expansion, there is little pressure for problemistic search that would cut it.

Billing software is the furthest from the firm's operational core and is only mentioned on the site, but it complements the airport software suite and slack allows the firm to carry it while its results remain uncertain.
Equipment monitoring draws on the installed base and service expertise and fits the lifecycle services direction at low resource cost, so it is unlikely to fall short enough to be dropped.
The controller safety alert service builds on the firm's tower and surveillance competence and serves safety goals, so absent a performance shortfall the firm keeps it.
